Definition: Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Beer is a place in the desert, the well where the Lord says to Moses, gather the people together and I will give them water. It is also the place where Jotham flees to dwell after his father's murder.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beer is the well of God's provision in the wilderness, because the people sing of it and the fugitive hides by it, and the same well gives water to the thirsty and shelter to the hunted.
